Order
% 06.01.2026 Crl.M.A. 37282/2025 (for exemption)
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

By way of this petition, the petitioner, who is the complainant in FIR No. 471/2021 dated 29.12.2021, under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, seeks the following reliefs:
"a. Set aside the impugned order dated 06.11.2025 passed by the learned ASJ, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi;
b. Cancel the bail granted to Respondent No. 2 under Section 439(2) Cr.P.C And Section 483(3) BNSS.
c. Direct Respondent No. 2 to be taken into judicial custody forthwith; d. Set aside the order dated 19.10.2024 of NDDLSA rejecting the victim's application and direct grant of compensation under Section 357A CrPC, Section 396 BNSS and Rule 12 of the Delhi Victim
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

2. Ms. Indu Kaul, learned counsel for the petitioner, does not press prayer (d) extracted above,
without prejudice to her right to seek independent remedies in that regard.
3.
Issue notice.
Ms. Manjeet Arya, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Notice to respondent No. 2 be served through the Investigating Officer.
4. Status report and replies be filed within four weeks from today.

5. List on 23.02.2026.
PRATEEK JALAN, J JANUARY 6, 2026 SS/AD/
